name: 32615 · Alachua, FL
findings: ZIP 32615 (Alachua) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32615 (Alachua) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32615 (Alachua) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
